title: Nullish vs OR difference
solution:
const zero = 0
const empty = ""
const falseVal = false
return {
  orZero: zero || "default",
  nullishZero: zero ?? "default",
  orEmpty: empty || "default",
  nullishEmpty: empty ?? "default"
}

?? sirf null/undefined ke liye default deta hai
